'''Shan Burku''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic trooper|trooper]] who served as member of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], together with two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahm Rendu|Tahm]] and [[Jace Rendu]], until the three were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an Imperial-allied individual.

==Behind the scenes==
Shan Burku appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite boss on Corellia. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
